review.why: Helps launch and grow an online community: playbooks by goal, platform choice, health metrics and an ambassador program.
review.summary: Starts from the community's identity and a flywheel, then gives playbooks for launching from zero, growing an existing group, running an advocate program and community-led support. It compares platforms, lists weekly health metrics with warning signs, and offers deliverables such as a channel plan, welcome journey and ritual calendar.
strengths: Launch playbook is concrete: recruit founders, seed posts, reply to everyone
Platform table lists the main drawback of each option
Warning signs make a health audit actionable
cautions: Thresholds such as DAU/MAU above 20% are rules of thumb
Community model details are in a file not read here
Little on moderation or conflict handling
